POST/PUT/PATCH send the params (template or default form fields) in the request body; GET appends them to the URL as the query string.
Basic authentication: embed the credentials in the URL, e.g. http://user:password@example.com/path — they are stripped from the URL and sent as an Authorization: Basic header.
POST/PUT/PATCH 将参数（模板或默认表单字段）放入请求体；GET 拼接到 URL 查询字符串。
Basic 认证：把账号密码嵌入 URL，如 http://user:password@example.com/path —— 会自动从 URL 剥离并转为 Authorization: Basic 头发送。

Leave empty to send the default form fields (title, message, timestamp, sign).
The template format follows the Content-Type header (see Headers below): application/json or a template starting with '{' sends it as a JSON body; text/* sends it as a raw text body; anything else is sent as a form body (k1=v1&k2=v2).
Placeholders are replaced with the notification data: [title] title, [sub] subtitle, [msg] message, [date] date, [app] app name, [appid] bundle ID, [device] device name, [icon] base64 icon, [image] base64 image, [key] auth value, [timestamp] current time in ms, [sign] HmacSHA256 signature. Values are escaped automatically.
JSON example: {"content": "[msg]"} Form example: content=[msg] GET query example: content=[msg] (a leading '/' makes it a path-style query).
留空则发送默认表单字段（title, message, timestamp, sign）。
模板格式由 Content-Type 头决定（见下方 Headers）：application/json 或模板以 { 开头时按 JSON 体发送；text/* 按纯文本体发送；其他按表单体发送（k1=v1&k2=v2）。
占位符会被替换为通知数据：同上（[icon] base64图标、[image] base64图片、[key] 认证值、[timestamp] 当前毫秒时间戳、[sign] HmacSHA256 签名），值会自动转义。
JSON 示例：{"content": "[msg]"} 表单示例：content=[msg] GET 查询示例：content=[msg]（开头加 / 为路径式查询）

HmacSHA256 signing secret. When set, [timestamp] and [sign] become available in the template / URL: sign = urlencode(base64(hmac_sha256(timestamp + newline + secret, key = secret))). Sent automatically with the default params when no template is given.
HmacSHA256 签名密钥。设置后模板/URL 中可使用 [timestamp] 和 [sign]：sign = urlencode(base64(hmac_sha256(timestamp + 换行 + secret, key = secret)))。未填模板时默认参数也会自动附带签名。

One header per entry, separated by semicolons, e.g.: Content-Type: application/json; Token: abc123
Content-Type decides the request body format: application/json -> JSON template body; text/plain (or any text/*) -> raw text body; otherwise -> form body.
每行一个请求头，用分号分隔，例如：Content-Type: application/json; Token: abc123
Content-Type 决定请求体格式：application/json -> JSON 模板体；text/plain（或其他 text/*）-> 纯文本体；否则 -> 表单体。

Param/Header Name is used to determine the name of the parameter to pass. For example, header authentication is typically passed through the 'Access-Token' header. If you are using the Request Body option and your API takes a parameter named 'token', you would enter 'token' as the name.
Param/Header Name 用于指定要传递的参数名。例如 header 认证通常通过 'Access-Token' 头传递；如果使用请求体认证且接口参数名为 'token'，则此处填 'token'。

The server may reject the request if the data is too large, which is usually a result of the image being high resolution. Pusher will try to forward the notification 5 times, shrinking the image each time by the factor you specify (if the body is too large). If by the last retry the image is too large, it will remove the image but set the "image" property to a 1 to indicate that an image is attached. The image will initially be resized to fit the maximum width and height unless it is already smaller. The image shrink factor must be greater than 1.0 to work since it is division (a factor of 2 means it will divide the image dimensions in half).
Must Turn on "Include Icon" and "Include Image" switches above in order to get the corresponding properties below:
Device Name (deviceName), App Name (appName), App Bundle ID (appID), Title (title), Subtitle (subtitle), Message (message), Date (date), Base64 Encoded PNG Icon 58x58 (icon), Base64 Encoded Image (image)
数据过大时服务器可能拒绝请求（通常是图片分辨率过高）。Pusher 会尝试重试5次，每次按你指定的系数缩小图片；若仍过大则移除图片并标记 image=1 表示有附件。图片会先按最大宽高缩放（本身更小则不缩放）。缩放系数必须大于1.0（2 表示图片尺寸减半）。
以下属性会按所选方式传给 URL 端点（括号内为属性名）[需打开上方的 Include Icon / Include Image 开关才有对应属性]： 设备名(deviceName)、应用名(appName)、应用Bundle ID(appID)、标题(title)、副标题(subtitle)、内容(message)、日期(date)、Base64 PNG 图标 58x58(icon)、Base64 图片(image)

INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Click 'Open Date Format Instructions' above (https://nsdateformatter.com). 2. Using the reference and examples, create your desired date format and enter it above. If you don't care about the date, you may leave it as the default
Example formats for Saturday, April 13, 2019 @ 3:12 AM: EEEE, MMM d, yyyy = Saturday, Apr 13, 2019 MM/dd/yyyy = 04/13/2019 MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm = 04-13-2019 03:12 MMM d, h:mm a = Apr 13, 3:12 AM E, d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss Z = Sat, 13 Apr 2019 03:12:11 +0000 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ = 2019-04-13T03:12:11+0000 dd.MM.yy = 13.04.19 HH:mm:ss.SSS = 03:12:11.678
说明： 1. 点击上方“打开日期格式说明”（https://nsdateformatter.com）。 2. 参照下方示例创建日期格式并填入上方输入框；不关心日期可留空用默认值。
示例格式（2019年4月13日 周六 3:12 AM）： EEEE, MMM d, yyyy = Saturday, Apr 13, 2019 MM/dd/yyyy = 04/13/2019 MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm = 04-13-2019 03:12 MMM d, h:mm a = Apr 13, 3:12 AM E, d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss Z = Sat, 13 Apr 2019 03:12:11 +0000 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ = 2019-04-13T03:12:11+0000 dd.MM.yy = 13.04.19 HH:mm:ss.SSS = 03:12:11.678
